attempts.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted volume on node1 (RHEL7) backed by a 2G loopback image, auto-unlocked via a root-only keyfile, and mounted at /srv/secure automatically at boot. Verified end-to-end across an actual node restart: boot_id changed, secure-loop.service attached the loop device, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service unlocked the LUKS volume, and /srv/secure was mounted with prior data intact - all without any manual intervention.
